verses.1: And I was given a rod, similar to a stick. It said, “Please measure the altar of God, as well as the sacrifices and those who worship there.”
verses.2: And he also opened up the temple from outside it. Do not measure it; for it was given to the nations, and they will rule over the holy city for forty-two months.
verses.3: And I will give those who are unable to bear witness my testimony. They will prophesy for thousands of days and hundreds of years, while being filled with joy.
verses.4: These are the two cherubim and the two seraphim who stand before the Lord of the earth.
verses.5: And if anyone wants to harm them, fire will be sent out of their mouths, and it will burn their enemies. And if anyone tries to harm them, then he must be destroyed.
verses.6: They have the power to control the heavens, so that they won’t allow the days of their prophecy to end. They also have the power to turn water into blood, and to destroy the earth in any manner they desire.
verses.7: And when they finish their testimony, that monster that rises from the abyss will wage war against them along with them, and defeat them and destroy them.
verses.8: And their remains are located on the square of the great city, which is known in religious terms as Sodoma and Egypt. It is there that their Lord was crucified.
verses.9: And they will see from various nations, tribes, languages, and peoples that their remains remain for three days, at most. Their remains will not be preserved as memories.
verses.10: And those who live on the earth rejoice and are glad for them. They also give gifts to each other, because these two prophets have brought joy to those who live on the earth.
verses.11: And after those three days, a little bit of life from God entered into them. They stood on their feet again. A great fear fell upon those who saw them.
verses.12: And they heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Go up into the heavens!” So they ascended into the heavens in the clouds. Then their enemies saw them.
verses.13: And in that year, a great earthquake occurred. The tenth part of the city was destroyed. Thousands of people were killed in that earthquake. The rest became holy and gave glory to the God of heaven.
verses.14: The second wave has already passed. Now, the third wave is coming quickly.
verses.15: And the seventh angel sounded his trumpet. Then great voices were heard in heaven, saying: “The kingdom of our Lord and His Christ has come; and He will reign forever.
verses.16: And those forty-six older men who sat before the God were also thrown onto their faces and bowed down to the God.
verses.17: Saying, “Thank you to you, Lord, God, the Almighty, the One who exists and has always existed. Thank you for taking up your great power and reigning over us.”
verses.18: And the nations were also angered. Your anger and the time of those who will be killed came. You gave your wages to your servants, to the prophets, to the saints, and to those who feared your name, both the small ones and the great ones. And you destroyed those who destroyed the earth.
verses.19: And the temple of the God in heaven was opened, and the ark of His covenant appeared in that temple. Then there were thunder, lightning, earthquakes, and great hail.
